title: Per-head temporal outlier smoothing + hybrid FP8/INT8 calibration harness for model-specific layer scaling
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build and validate a model-specific calibration workflow that combines per-head temporal outlier smoothing with a hybrid FP8/INT8 quantization profile. Goal: recover accuracy regressions seen in prior blanket layer-scaling approaches while preserving latency/throughput gains. Deliverables: (1) calibration harness that emits per-layer/per-head statistics over sliding token windows; (2) an automated rescaler that suggests fine-grained multiplicative corrections per head; (3) hybrid quant profiles (FP8 where sensitive, INT8 elsewhere) and rollout plan for runtime-1.20.
comments: 2026-02-11 | Aisha Patel: Kickoff — scoped work after postmortem of ENG-75432-style failures. Key observation: some heads show transient spikes that break static per-layer scalers. Hypothesis: smoothing across a short temporal window and clipping headwise variance will reduce calibration fragility when we switch to FP8 for attention projections.

2026-02-17 | Marco Chen: Prototype completed — added sliding-window (200 token) head stats to the calibration harness. Initial runs on llama-2-13b show perplexity delta +0.7% vs FP16 baseline when using naive per-layer scaling; with headwise temporal smoothing we reduce delta to +0.15%.

2026-02-20 | Priya Nair (ML Research): Reviewed prototype. Feedback: need separate handling for Mistral-style echo heads that have heavy activation skew; suggested adding skew-aware clipping (median absolute deviation threshold) and a recovery path for heads that oscillate rapidly.

2026-02-25 | Marco Chen: Added skew-aware clipping and hybrid profile selector. On Mistral-7B testbed: hybrid profile (FP8 for FFN+attn KV cache, INT8 quant for output projections) yields 1.1x throughput improvement with <0.2% ROUGE-L regression on summarization eval set.

2026-03-01 | Design Review (Samira Ortega): UX note — console should flag models using hybrid profiles and expose per-route fallback to FP16. Will follow up with console ticket to add rollout toggles.

2026-03-03 | Security (Ethan Park): Quick review — no new key material or network changes. Marking security_review_required=false. Recommended adding audit log events for automatic rescale proposals. Scheduled follow-up for audit log implementation in Private deployments.

2026-03-04 | Marco Chen: Benchmarks — Qwen-8B end-to-end inference test (batch=1, seq=512): latency median increased 2ms vs INT8 baseline but token cost reduced by ~28%. Accuracy: EM on QA dev set lowered 0.4% absolute vs FP16 baseline with headwise smoothing active; without smoothing, regression was 1.6%.

2026-03-05 | Aisha Patel: Decision: proceed with hybrid FP8/INT8 rollout under runtime-1.20 as experimental feature flag. Next steps: integrate rescaler into calibration CLI, add automated validation job in CI that runs new eval suite on a 3-model matrix (Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-8B), and prepare canary rollout plan for Dedicated customers.

Action items: Marco — PR for CLI integration and rescaler algorithm (due 2026-03-10). Priya — finalize threshold defaults and create short eval doc with failure modes (due 2026-03-08). Samira — Console toggle mockups (due 2026-03-09).
notes: Implementation uses online sliding-window stats to compute per-head mean, variance, skew. Rescaler proposes multiplicative adjustments clamped to [0.85, 1.15] by default. Hybrid profile selector picks FP8 for layers where calibrated KL divergence to FP16 < 0.02 and INT8 for remaining layers. All thresholds exposed as CLI flags for tuning. CI will run full eval matrix nightly during canary period.
validation_plan: 1) Calibration runs generate per-layer/per-head reports and candidate rescale suggestions. 2) Automated validation job runs generation+QA/eval suites against FP16 baseline and records P95 latency, throughput, token-cost delta, and task-level metrics (EM, ROUGE, BLEU, perplexity). 3) Canary: 5% of traffic on dedicated pool for two days; if accuracy regressions exceed thresholds (EM drop >0.5 or ROUGE-L drop >0.8), rollback to previous profile automatically. 4) Post-canary A/B analysis and playbook updates.
metrics: Target accuracy: within 0.5% absolute of FP16 across tasks; latency target: <= +5% median; cost target: >= 20% token-cost reduction vs FP16 when hybrid profile engaged. Current experimental results: Llama-2-13B perplexity delta +0.15%, Mistral-7B ROUGE-L delta -0.18%, Qwen-8B EM delta -0.4%.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: heads that oscillate cause flip-flopping of rescale proposals and noisy rollouts. Mitigation: require stabilization window (12 hours of consistent suggestion) before auto-deploying rescale, and add conservative default clamps. Risk: FP8 numeric instability on rare activations — mitigation: per-batch overflow counters and automatic fallback to INT8/FP16 for the affected layer in-flight.
next_steps: (1) Merge PR and land CLI integration. (2) Add nightly CI job that validates candidate profiles against 3-model matrix. (3) Create console rollout UI ticket and Dedicated canary plan. (4) Prepare runbook for rollback and incident playbook.
